name: Rubuska
bio: Archetype: Bloodtithe, AFK healing, ST buff. ⌽ Gains [Bloodtithe] when losing HP. All allies lose HP at turn start though [Shadow Field]. ⌽ Grants all allies [Shadow Cloak], which stacks based on self HP lost or skill usage and grants buffs based on its stacks. ⌽ Heals all allies after any of them take a hit. All heals cannot crit. ⌽ Ultimate concentrates accumulated buffs onto one ally for one (or two at P1) turns. ⌽ Prevents ally death (once per ally).
